script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The parking joke puts Papa into the scene by saying what he would have asked there. He never makes himself part of a Bible event.
The certificate punchline makes the Father the subject of the joke by imagining Him signing a certificate.
Calling the crowd's statements guesses adds uncertainty the text does not state.
Saying the crowd is guessing adds a mental state the text does not give. It reports what they said.
Calling the two statements guesses adds uncertainty the text does not state.
The text says some in the crowd said it had thundered and others said an angel had spoken. It does not say they were trying to decide whether it was thunder.
The explanation repeats the answer and verse without adding much, and the final line is especially flat.
The explanation is a series of plain restatements with little of Papa's warmth or voice.
